responses.answer: I performed a multi-step analysis to answer your question about NVIDIA's financial performance. First, I searched through the available financial filings and found comprehensive data about NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 results [1]. The search revealed that NVIDIA achieved record revenue of $60.9 billion, representing a 126% year-over-year increase [1]. The analysis shows this growth was primarily driven by the Data Center segment, which reached $47.5 billion in revenue - a remarkable 217% increase [1]. This demonstrates NVIDIA's successful transition from primarily a gaming GPU company to a leader in AI infrastructure and data center acceleration.
